report: Read all 18 verses end to end against the 21-lemma candidate table; every multi-treatment bucket is the ASV rendering one word differently (my/me/Mine for the 1cs suffix; and/also/Yea/but/nor/so that for waw; to/unto/upon/from/of/unrepresented for lamed), and each difference is licensed by what the ASV wrote. No construction was analysed two ways.

The one construction that recurs twice in a recastable shape — עָצְמוּ מִן in vv. 5 and 12 (They are more than ...) — is treated identically both times: the verb keeps *They are*, the comparative מִן takes *more than* headed on *than* under rule 24, and both notes name the competing reading. The two בְּתוֹךְ fusions (vv. 8, 10) differ only in the copula rule 49 adds to the predicate one.

Checked the added units (v2 asyndetic *and*, v3 appositional *even* and object *it*, v5 two supplied relatives, *If* and *of them*, v12 surplus *up*, v17 asyndetic *Yet*) against rules 14, 16, 44, 55: each stands where no morpheme licenses it, and none is folded elsewhere in another verse.

v7 כָּתוּב → *it is written* keeps the impersonal *it* with the participle and names the rule 20 added reading as competing; left as hedged, since a passive participle's English dummy subject is on the same footing as rule 17's *there was lifted up* and the corpus's *as it is written* units, and the note already records the alternative.

BSB disagreements (6): all convention differences, none a genuine error — v4 אֶל silenced by *respecteth* (rule 40); v6 לִּי dative recast as *Mine* (rule 40); v12 עָלַי object promoted to *me* with *about* kept as the verb's particle (rules 40, 44); v5 2ms suffix on נִפְלְאֹת left unrendered because the ASV's *thou* realizes the explicit אַתָּה and *which* points at the works; v13 paragogic he (rule 32); v17 lexicalized suffix of אֲדֹנָי (rule 57).
The five repeated notes the validator flags all restate contract rules (15, 17/25, 29, 36) and need no convention. Nothing in the chapter generalises beyond the contract.
